part 1 (pages 1-17): Section C, C.4: the source says 'If Q.4 is zero, specify reason'. The 'Specify' reason field is not recorded as a question or a text option, so the zero-telephone reason is dropped.

part 1 (pages 1-17): Section D, D.3/D.4: the 'If no spouse, go to Q.5' jump is printed with the spouse question (Q.4) but is recorded as leaving D.3, and also as a condition on D.4.
